title: Twig Toolbox class pack
description: A dialect pack's deep class model, shipped as its own file and loaded on the first member lookup. Objects are the same shape as a pack's own, and are stored inheritance-factored: each carries only what its class declares, and names its parent in `extends`. Members carry no `docsUrl` — the class reference's URL is derived at runtime from the declaring class, the kind and the name.

pack.description: Name of the dialect pack that owns these classes. Their activation and version gating are that pack's.
